comment: Drift fixtures shared by stats::drifted (Rust) and bench/validate.py (Python). n = 2, every round 16 ms; a round's rate is 2 n^3 iterations / elapsed / 1e9, computed as the harness does. Expected flags were computed in IEEE doubles, so nominal 5% changes land on either side of the limit.

cases.name: nine rounds are never checked, even at 2x
nominal +5% at 1.0 GFLOP/s rounds above the limit
nominal -5% at 1.0 GFLOP/s rounds above the limit
nominal +5% at 3.0 GFLOP/s rounds below the limit
nominal -5% at 3.0 GFLOP/s rounds below the limit
exactly 0.05 at 20.0 GFLOP/s is not more than the limit
nominal +5% at 11.0 GFLOP/s rounds above the limit
rounds between the windows are ignored
window medians, not first and last rounds
outliers inside a window do not move its median
